meta.name: KLEPON
meta.description: Fire design tools for Revit — steel-navy and signal green.
meta.note: This file is the only place these values get typed by hand. Every consumer (website, plugin, anything else) generates from it — see scripts/. If a value needs to change, change it here first, then regenerate.

bg.role: = color.neutral.bg. Duplicate-named on purpose: the website's markup uses the utility class bg-brand-bg (not bg-bg) in several places, so this alias has to exist under this exact key for that class to keep resolving.

navy.role: Primary ink. Body text, headings, and — at full opacity as a fill — the dark 'premium panel' surface (footer, CTA banners).

navy-700.role: Lighter navy step, used sparingly (e.g. Nav.astro hover states).

green.role: The one accent. Literal fill color in the real logo file (klepon-mark / klepon-logo) — not a guess. Anchors ramp step 600.

green-600.role: = brand.green. Large fills: buttons, icon badges.

green-700.role: Deliberately darker than a straight tonal step — this is the text-sized green (body/label/links) on a light ground. A literal mid-green step fails WCAG AA there; 700 passes.

slate.role: Secondary accent, not yet wired into either consumer. General-purpose (data viz, illustration) — not a semantic error/warning color.

teal.role: Secondary accent, not yet wired into either consumer.

orange.role: Secondary accent, not yet wired into either consumer.

amber.role: Secondary accent — sparing highlight moments (kicker underlines, single-word emphasis).

surface.role: Secondary surface fill, one step back from the page.

divider.role: Every hairline border/rule. valueFlat+opacity given for platforms without color-mix().

fontFamily.role: One family for both display and body — no second typeface.

heading.case: sentence-case by default; uppercase survives only on eyebrow/kicker labels and status chips, never on H1/H2/H3 body headings.

micro.role: Micro-label floor — functional/status text should not go below this except micro-sm's documented cases.

label.role: Label / Eyebrow — the small kicker above nearly every section heading.

body.role: Default paragraph size in tight contexts (cards, dense UI).

bodyLarge.role: Section-intro paragraph size (Tailwind's own text-lg) — the size actually used under most section headings on the marketing site.

2xl.role: Small icon chips and compact badges.

3xl.role: Full content cards and panels (the default card radius).

base.role: 0.85x density multiplier — p-1 = 3.4px, p-4 = 13.6px, etc. Tailwind-scale-specific; a non-Tailwind consumer should treat this as an 3.4px base spacing unit.

buttonPrimary.note: White-on-green is the live convention (confirmed 2026-08-3x): measures ~3.2:1 contrast, passing for large/bold text but missing the 4.5:1 AA threshold for normal button text — a known, accepted tradeoff, not an oversight. Do not silently 'fix' this to navy-on-green without checking current guidance.
